title: Correct the Lorcana symbol provenance: the Director's own drawings or Ravensburger public digital assets
actor: Claude Code agent (architect/QA reviewer role) on Director request, local WSL session

changes.description: CHG-20261021-001 described the source folder (all-lorcana-assets in the original Inkspire app) as an official asset pack of unrecorded origin and the symbols as official. The Director states most, if not all, of its files are the Director's own drawings and the rest come directly from Ravensburger's publicly available digital assets. The symbol manifest now records that origin (per-file split not distinguished) with the exact D07 rights basis and a note that D07 applies to both; the 'official' colour mode becomes 'fixed'.

Current descriptions corrected in place: symbol-lib, GameSymbol and InkIdentity contracts and comments, the provider's takedown-switch documentation (covers anything depicting Lorcana marks, whoever drew it), the story helper, a browser test title and the runbook. Dated corrections appended to ADR 0017, the validation record and the fan-content policy rather than rewriting them. The symbol choice stands on its technical grounds.
